summary.intent: Fix a failing lint CI check on PR #455 caused by a pnpm version mismatch introduced by upgrading pnpm/action-setup from v5 to v6.
summary.outcome: Added `"packageManager": "pnpm@10.33.0"` to package.json to force action-setup v6 to install the correct pnpm version, and expanded `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` to include `@nestjs/core` and `@scarf/scarf` which were missing from the prior fix attempt.

repo: cipher-box uses pnpm workspaces with a monorepo structure under /Users/myankelev/Code/random/cipher-box
CI uses multiple workflow files: ci.yml, deploy-staging.yml, desktop-e2e.yml, desktop-release.yml, load-test.yml, web-e2e.yml — all reference pnpm/action-setup
package.json already had a partial `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` list that was missing @nestjs/core and @scarf/scarf
pnpm store path reveals the effective pnpm major version: store/v10 = pnpm 10, store/v11 = pnpm 11

code.finding: Added `"packageManager": "pnpm@10.33.0"` field — action-setup v6 prioritizes this over the `version:` workflow input, preventing silent pnpm 11-rc installation. Also added @nestjs/core and @scarf/scarf to pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies.
Uses `pnpm/action-setup@v6` with `version: 10` input, but v6 was silently resolving to pnpm 11-rc, ignoring the version input in favor of the latest available.

workflow: pnpm/action-setup v6 prioritizes the `packageManager` field in package.json over the `version:` workflow input — pinning via packageManager is the correct approach
pnpm 11 (even RC) treats ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS as a hard error (exit 1) rather than a warning as in pnpm 10 — onlyBuiltDependencies must be exhaustive
Comparing CI store paths between passing and failing runs is an effective way to detect unexpected pnpm version changes without direct version logging
pnpm 11 stable was not yet released at time of session (only RC), making upgrading to v11 not viable

friction: The root cause (action-setup v6 ignoring `version: 10` and installing pnpm 11-rc) was non-obvious and required extensive log mining to confirm via store path comparison
A prior fix attempt had already added onlyBuiltDependencies to package.json but was incomplete — missing @nestjs/core and @scarf/scarf — causing continued failures and confusion
Went down a dead-end path of upgrading all workflows to `version: 11` before discovering pnpm 11 was only RC and required Node >= 22.13, requiring full revert
Multiple round-trips of editing workflow files (update to v11, then revert all) added significant churn
CI logs required many targeted bash queries to extract pnpm version and store path information that should have been directly visible
open_items: Workflow files still have `version: 10` as a fallback input — this is now redundant given the packageManager field but left in place; could be cleaned up
When pnpm 11 reaches stable release, the project will need to migrate (lockfile format is compatible, but onlyBuiltDependencies list must remain exhaustive)
No test was run to verify the fix works in CI — success depends on the push triggering a green run on PR #455
